data_availability_text: Data availability.Raw sequence reads are available through the Sequence Read Archive (PRJNA902000). Both metabolomics and processed sequence data has been archived on Dryad (https://doi.org/10.7280/D1KH5N). The R scripts used to analyze all data are available on GitHub (https://github.com/sjbd1/5xfAD_mBio2022).
